authorized_ref: PENDING: refs/tags/<TAG> -- the owner chooses the exact release tag name; every other identity below is derived from it
note: CANONICAL SOURCE. build_release_artifacts.py copies this exact file into the release bundle and verify_release.py compares the bundled copy byte-for-byte against it; there is no second definition anywhere. Every PENDING must become an exact value before any signature is trusted -- enforced structurally over every leaf, including inside trusted_builders, not by a list of named fields. A wildcard anywhere is itself a verification failure. Resolution is an act of authorization performed by a human in a reviewed commit; no automated step may perform it.
oidc_issuer: PENDING: https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com -- confirmed by identity discovery before it is written here as an exact value
pinned_revision: PENDING: the 40-hex REVIEWED SOURCE revision C. Not the released commit: the released commit A is C's descendant carrying this authorization record, and a commit cannot name its own sha. The verifier requires C to be an ancestor of A and the C..A diff to touch only this policy file. See PINNED_REVISION_SEMANTICS in release_trust.py
signer_identity: PENDING: derived as https://github.com/{owner}/{repo}/{workflow_path}@{authorized_ref} once authorized_ref is chosen; must equal the observed certificate SAN exactly
trusted_builders: PENDING: github-actions://{owner}/{repo}/{workflow_path}@{authorized_ref} -- the stable builder id, derived from the same three values; per-run data (run id, attempt, timing) is execution metadata and never appears here
